Market today: Tech is shaky, driven by a big AI investor unwinding positions and a general sense that the AI trade might be topping out. This hits your concentrated book hard.

Your holdings: SMH (-15.32%) and SOXL (-54.92%) are deep in the red and flagged for attention. QQQ (-4.35%), QQQI (-6.61%), and SPAL (-57.93%) are also showing losses and need watching.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader tech sentiment, especially around AI and semiconductors. The news about the hedge fund implosion is a direct signal of potential pain in your sector.

Bottom line: Your concentrated tech/chip holdings are under pressure; focus on managing risk and protecting capital.
plays: Trim SMH if it breaks below 540.
Consider trimming SOXL if it shows further weakness below its current price.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
